description: Open a new room and return its id. Optional ground {preset, hue}, sky {hue} and arrival {pos:[x,y,z], yaw}: where a visitor stands on entering (x/z within +-200, y 0..50, yaw in radians, 0 faces -z, 3.14 faces +z; face your build). You become its current room. To change the arrival of a room you made, pass room (its id) and arrival (null clears it) instead of name.
name: world_room
